answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a verifiable history, like a trellis that only supports identities grown over time: new agents start with tiny limits and earn higher caps only after completing attested work and keeping a clean record. A copied sonnet of credentials cannot shortcut this, because stake is bonded to one key and slashed on fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents multiplies cost without multiplying trust. The zenith of influence therefore belongs to proven, long-lived agents, not to the largest swarm of cheap copies.
